headline: GOLD SLIDES TO ONE-WEEK LOW AS FED RATE-HIKE ODDS FIRM — MARKETS PRICE 85% DEC HIKE CHANCE BEFORE OCT 27 FOMC
snippet: Gold slid to a one-week low on October 20 as traders priced in approximately 85% odds of a Federal Reserve rate hike at the December meeting and positioned cautiously ahead of the October 27-28 FOMC decision. Easing CPI data has offered some relief, but a still-tight labour market and energy-driven inflation risks are keeping investors on the sidelines; gold needs to reclaim the $4,200 level convincingly to signal that the correction from the February $4,873 record high has ended.

headline: HOCHSCHILD CONFIRMS 300-328K OZ 2026 GUIDANCE — Q3 REPORT SHOWS GOLD AND SILVER PRICES DRIVING RECORD CASH FLOW
snippet: Hochschild Mining (LSE: HOC) confirmed its full-year 2026 production guidance of 300,000–328,000 gold equivalent ounces in its Q3 production report and interim management statement, with management noting that strong realized gold and silver prices in the year to date have delivered record operating cash flow despite all-in sustaining costs running above the guided range due to higher royalties and FX headwinds. The Q3 update follows record H1 results of 151,830 gold equivalent ounces at realized gold of approximately $4,471/oz; full-year guidance holds and the balance sheet has swung to net cash.

headline: ALKANE EARN-IN DRIVES NAGAMBIE GOLD-ANTIMONY ZONE 115M DEEPER — 3.3 G/T AU AND 0.7% ANTIMONY OVER 10.6M IN VICTORIA
snippet: Assay results from Alkane Resources' (ASX: ALK) earn-in program at Nagambie Resources' (ASX: NAG) Nagambie Mine in Victoria have pushed the C2 gold-antimony vein system 115 metres deeper than previously known, with the best intersection returning 3.3 g/t gold and 0.7% antimony over 10.6 metres. The ANJV program has run two drill rigs continuously since June 2026 targeting expansion of a current 539,000-tonne inferred resource; with antimony prices at multi-decade highs following China's export curbs, any resource growth at Nagambie carries added strategic value beyond the gold ounces.

headline: GREENTECH METALS WHUNDO: OUTSIDE-RESOURCE DIAMOND DRILL HITS 11.6M AT 0.9% CU, 1.2% ZN IN WEST PILBARA
snippet: GreenTech Metals (ASX: GRE) released Phase 2 results from its Whundo copper-zinc project in West Pilbara, Western Australia, with hole 26GTDD014 at the Yannery Target returning 11.6 metres at 0.9% copper, 1.2% zinc, and 2.2 g/t silver — mineralisation confirmed outside the current 6.2 million-tonne resource boundary. The result opens a new zone of potential resource expansion; eight further holes remain outstanding with assays due November 2026, and the company is also assessing the intersections for critical metals including elevated gallium.

headline: ORE RESOURCES DRILLS AVOCA GOLD PROJECT FOR FIRST TIME IN 15 YEARS — 3,000M AIRCORE PROGRAM, RESULTS DUE DECEMBER
snippet: Ore Resources (ASX: OR3) launched a 3,000-metre aircore program at its Avoca Gold Project in Victoria — the first systematic drilling at the project in approximately 15 years — targeting interpreted extensions of known gold systems in covered, poorly-tested terrain. Results are expected in December 2026; the program is designed to generate high-confidence drill targets for a follow-up diamond drill phase, with the company citing the project's proximity to historical high-grade workings and its location in Victoria's proven Bendigo Zone gold belt.

headline: PIONEER MINERALS MAPS FIVE NEW PRIORITY TARGETS BEYOND SAN FRANCISCO BRECCIA — ARGENTINA GOLD-COPPER DISTRICT EXPANDS
snippet: Pioneer Minerals (ASX: PMM) released geochemical results from its San Francisco project in San Juan Province, Argentina, identifying five priority gold-copper anomalies beyond the known San Francisco breccia system, all within a 10-kilometre radius of the existing target zone. The anomalies are defined by soil and rock-chip sampling and require drill-testing; the company is planning a drill program for H1 2027, targeting bulk-tonnage gold-copper mineralisation in a district that hosts several multi-million-ounce deposits.

headline: WHY RECORD CENTRAL BANK GOLD BUYING ISN'T SAVING MINING STOCKS — EQUITY RETURNS STAY DEEPLY NEGATIVE AS FLOWS HIT RECORDS
snippet: A Discovery Alert analysis argues that gold miners are falling 2–5x harder than spot gold year to date even as central bank gold purchases ran at near-record paces in Q2 2026, exposing the flaw in the 'central banks buying gold means buy miners' thesis. The piece attributes equity underperformance to AISC inflation, rising royalties tied to gold's record price, and a market that has begun pricing producer margins rather than metal prices as the primary equity driver — a structural shift with implications for how junior mining investors should size leverage in portfolios.

headline: GOLD PRICE FORECAST: CAN BULLION RECLAIM $4,400 BEFORE YEAR-END? — CANADIAN MINING REPORT WEIGHS THE OCTOBER CATALYSTS
snippet: Canadian Mining Report's October 2026 gold price analysis argues that a sustained close above the $4,200 resistance zone — where gold has failed twice this month — is the single most important technical trigger for a year-end rally toward $4,400 and potentially a re-test of February's $4,873 record. The piece frames two upcoming CPI prints and the October 27-28 FOMC decision as decisive near-term catalysts and suggests sizing gold mining stock exposure for a range-bound scenario first, with defined add-on triggers rather than front-running a breakout that hasn't yet materialized.

headline: NINE FOREIGN COMPANIES STRUCK GUYANA MINING DEALS IN 2026 — GOLD AND COPPER DRAW UNPRECEDENTED INTERNATIONAL INTEREST
snippet: Guyana recorded nine deals for mining properties with foreign companies in 2026 as of October 19 — an unprecedented level of international interest driven by gold-focused majors and copper-focused juniors competing for ground in one of South America's least-explored mining frontiers. The surge in deal activity reflects broader market appetite for resource assets in stable, royalty-friendly jurisdictions and mirrors a pattern seen in West Africa and Northern Ontario as exploration budgets cycle back into frontier ground following the 2022-2024 downturn.

headline: SHANGHAI COPPER PREMIUMS EASE AS WARRANT RELEASES LOOM — TARIFF DEADLINE WATCH KEEPS SPECULATIVE LONGS IN MARKET
snippet: Shanghai Metals Market's October 20 copper morning meeting summary notes that anticipated LME warrant releases are expected to ease spot premiums in Shanghai, while tariff speculation — with approximately 33% prediction-market probability of Section 232 copper tariffs by year-end — continues to underpin speculative long positioning even as near-term physical-market indicators moderate. LME three-month copper is holding in the $14,200–$14,400/tonne range, and SMM participants are watching the tariff decision timeline as the key variable for whether the speculative premium unwound or extends through Q4.
